channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Stihl President, CEO Chris Keffer leaves the company
item.description: Stihl's Lorraine Amesbury Holder and Uwe Hirsch will assume responsibility for overseeing the president’s duties.

item.title: SpringGreen hosts National Advisory Council meeting
item.description: During the meeting, participants reviewed system updates, discussed opportunities for improvement and shared insights from their local markets.

item.title: Schill Grounds Management acquires Brogan Landscaping
item.description: The acquisition adds two new branches to Schill’s growing Mid-Atlantic footprint.

item.title: LandCare names Richardson as branch manager of Atlanta South location
item.description: Lance Richardson brings 15 years of industry experience to LandCare.

item.title: Kevin and Lorraine Kehoe Foundation pledges $750K to industry scholarships, workshops
item.description: The gift, to be distributed in three annual installments of $250,000 from 2026 through 2028, is the largest contribution in the NALP Foundation’s history.

item.title: WAC Group introduces new products at Illuminate 2026
item.description: These includes the new Outdoor X Track System and the new Landscape Lighting Path Lights.

item.title: What we learned at the NALP Leaders Forum
item.description: We took home lessons from California that included H-2B updates, our economic outlook and more.

item.title: Our February issue is now live
item.description: Find out what sets apart a winning vehicle wrap, plus thoughts on rent-versus-own equipment and how weather will impact this year's supply chain.

item.title: Coalmarch Marketing adds ROI reporting capability
item.description: The update is for lawn care owners and operators using RealGreen and will be available in Q2 of this year.

item.title: Bartlett Tree Experts acquires Olympia Tree Care
item.description: The move was made official when Ronnie Hoover, certified arborist and owner of Olympia Tree Care, decided to retire.
